_read_me: Every color fact in this file is marked needs_stylist_review: true. A licensed stylist should check each one, fix anything wrong, and then set that flag to false. Edit the words and numbers only. Keep the ids (like "yellow-orange") exactly as they are, because the lesson uses them to connect things. Hex values like #c4621f are the on-screen swatch colors and are illustrations, not formulas.

hook.line: She asked for ash. She got orange. Here's why.
hook.swatch_label: Brassy blonde: orange-gold warmth showing through

pigments.name: Red-orange
pigments.review_note: Not in the original brief. Toner inferred from the color wheel (blue-green sits opposite red-orange). Please confirm.

pigments.name: Gold-orange
pigments.review_note: Not in the original brief. Gold-orange sits between orange and yellow-orange, so the lesson accepts blue or blue-violet. On the wheel it is drawn on the yellow-orange slice. Please confirm.

pigments.name: Pale yellow
pigments.review_note: Not in the original brief. Treated as a lighter yellow, so violet cancels it. Please confirm.

toners.name: Violet
toners.wrong_effect: Violet only has enough pull to cancel yellow. Deeper warmth shows right through it, and the result looks dull and muddy.

toners.name: Blue-violet
toners.wrong_effect: Blue-violet is aimed at yellow-orange. On other tones it only half works, so some warmth stays behind.

toners.name: Blue
toners.wrong_effect: Blue is built for orange. Put it on yellow and you get a green cast, because blue plus yellow makes green. On red it barely makes a dent.

toners.name: Blue-green
toners.wrong_effect: Blue-green is aimed at red-orange. On lighter, yellower hair it reads green instead of neutral.

toners.name: Green
toners.wrong_effect: Green is for red. On yellow or orange it has nothing to fight, so the hair ends up swampy or khaki.

beyond_developer.text: That's more lift than a tint and developer usually gives in one go. This is lightener territory.
beyond_developer.review_note: Not in the original brief. Shown when the lift is more than 4 levels. Please confirm.

color_doesnt_lift_color.title: Color doesn't lift color.
color_doesnt_lift_color.text: Tint can't lighten artificial color, no matter the developer. To go lighter on colored hair, you need lightener.

no_lift.text: Your target isn't lighter than where you start. No lift means no new warmth gets exposed.

scenarios.client: A regular. Natural level 6. She wants a clean level 9 blonde with no warmth.
A new client. Natural level 4. She wants two levels lighter and wants it to read cool, not brassy.
A walk-in. Natural level 5. She wants a soft, neutral level 8.
